study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Wolfers et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Replicating extensive brain structural heterogeneity in individuals with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study and selected from the NoDa database. The study uses three non-overlapping samples (Discovery, Replication 1, Replication 2) from this cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study... The two replication samples were selected from the TOP-database... As the discovery sample, we selected 256 healthy individuals...

answer.TOP: Normative model training/testing (HC) and clinical validation (SZ/BP) for Replication 1 and 2; Discovery sample used for reference

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy individuals in Replication 1 and 2 samples were used to estimate normative models (under 10-fold cross-validation). Patients (SZ, BP) in Replication 1 and 2 were used to test deviations. The Discovery sample (from Wolfers et al., 2018) results are presented for comparison.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For replication sample 1, we included... 400 healthy individuals... estimated the normative range for this model in healthy individuals under 10-fold cross-validation, and then applied one model across all healthy individuals to patients... In the lower panel, we depict results based on the data reported in Wolfers et al. 2018
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Wolfers2021.pdf.md: Methods / Participants; Methods / Normative modeling; Figure 1 Caption

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative models were estimated using Gaussian Process Regression on healthy individuals. The study mentions 10-fold cross-validation on the healthy controls, and applying one model (trained on all healthy controls) to patients.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: For replication sample 1, we included... 400 healthy individuals... As the replication sample 2, we included 312 healthy individuals... we estimated the normative range for this model in healthy individuals under 10-fold cross-validation, and then applied one model across all healthy individuals to patients
